QuestInfo.name: A Darkness Greater Than Light
QuestInfo.0: Neinheart was no help. Talk to Empress Cygnus instead.
QuestInfo.1: You asked the Empress questions about your father and about yourself, but she didn't give you any straight answers. Someone's hiding the truth. It's time to go out there and pursue it.
QuestInfo.2: You asked the Empress questions about your father and about yourself, but she didn't give you any straight answers. Someone's hiding the truth. It's time to go out there and pursue it.
QuestInfo.parent: Where in Maple World is Chromile the Knight?
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 1,000
Can proceed to Quest for the Truth

0.0: Mihile! You seem troubled.\r\n#L0##bI am haunted, Empress. The more I find out about my father, the more lost I feel...#l\n#k
0.1: I have heard nothing but good tales of your fathers' bravery and loyalty. I didn't know him myself, but I would not discount the tales of those who had.\r\n#L0##bHow can anyone ever live up to those stories, highness? You searched for a knight of ultimate purity... but you only found me.#l\n#k
0.2: I began the search for Chromile because of the stories, but I didn't expect any single man to live up to those tales. I only wanted a person I could trust, and that is exactly what I found. I found the Knight of Light, and I do not regret it.\r\n#L0##bEveryone keeps calling me that, but I don't see how you can be so sure. I don't remember anything about my childhood. What if I'm not the person you were trying to find?#l\n#k
0.3: Sometimes we must trust in things we cannot see. I feel the power of light inside you, Mihile. Please believe in me, if nothing else.\r\n#L0##bI do, highness, but... won't I be devoured by the darkness like Chromile?#l\n#k
0.4: Light and dark are part of a whole. Neither side should fear the other. Calm yourself and you will find the clarity you need to see past this crisis of faith.

yes.0: I hope your sorrow and worries leave you soon.

no.0: I know times are difficult, but you must press on.

1.0: The Empress's words seem to have parted the clouds above my head. I think I can get back to my search.

npc.0: I hope your sorrow and worries leave you soon.
